notes: Only Alpha > 127 is used; invisible RGB in Alpha=0 pixels is never inspected or treated as halo.
Expected grids locate subject components only. Recommended GPU regions are not constrained to equal cells.
Each minimal rectangle contains its complete own Alpha > 127 component. A foreign-subject pixel in this minimum is impossible to remove with any larger complete rectangular region.
Padding uses original PNG pixels only; no image file is rewritten, cropped, resized, masked or composited.
GPU regions are geometry recommendations, not animation-phase or anatomical-handedness approval; uniform character scale/anchor is a separate runtime concern.
